# AffordableHousing.com

> National platform connecting property owners and tenants with Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher programs, HUD-assisted rentals, and affordable housing resources across all 50 states.

AffordableHousing.com serves as a comprehensive rental listing service for Section 8 and affordable housing, featuring state-specific housing authority portals, centralized waiting lists, and tools like QuikMatch and Market Rent Reports for landlords and tenants navigating government housing programs including Project-Based Vouchers (PBV) and the Family Unification Program.

## Key Topics

- Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program
- HUD (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development)
- Rental Assistance Programs
- Centralized Waiting Lists
- Property Owner Benefits & Landlord Tools
- QuikMatch Tenant Matching
- Market Rent Reports
- Project-Based Voucher (PBV)
- Family Unification Program
- Section 8 Rental Listings
- Affordable Housing Search
- Tenant Screening & Applicant Management
- State Housing Authorities (VSHA, DHAA)
- Government Housing Programs
- Free Property Listings for Owners

## State Housing Authority Portals

- [Vermont State Housing Authority](https://vermont.affordablehousing.com/): VSHA Section 8 rental assistance program serving 8500+ Vermont families
- [Delaware Centralized Waiting List](https://delaware.affordablehousing.com/): DHAA centralized waiting list for Delaware Section 8 voucher programs
- [Maine Affordable Housing Hub](https://maine.affordablehousing.com/): Maine housing hub for rental assistance programs and waiting lists

## Property Owner Resources

- [Owner Benefits & Listing Service](https://custompages.affordablehousing.com/owner/benefits): Property owner benefits: list Section 8 rentals and connect with tenants
- [Help Center for Property Owners](https://help.affordablehousing.com/owners): Help center for property owners with FAQs and platform instructions
